revisions.prompt: Revise this same illustration of a single LARGE YELLOW PAPER passport sheet in France in1815. Make the paper flexible and usable, recently issued and carried for a few days: keep soft fold creases, but remove every tear, hole, crumbling edge, heavy age stain and brittle split. Remove the circular official stamp/seal completely. Reduce all handwriting to faint indistinct broken pen strokes, with NO readable words, personal names, dates, numbers, headings, signature or invented official device.
